independentReview.result: Exact collector/workflow source review closed; no package omission, native environment substitution, masked refusal failure or atomic-checkpoint weakening.
independentReview.limits: Source review only; reviewer did not rerun the controls or inspect their raw logs.

preservedHistory.result: Initial compiler change matched the authorization condition instead of the compiler condition. Controls caught missing normal CGO metadata and weakened install refusal. The original install-only authorization condition was restored before wider checks.
The original normal-privatefs count assertion included the newly separate refusal invocation. It now counts only the complete positive package run; the refusal has its own exact assertions.
A subsequent control run reported Windows PermissionError during os.replace in an existing synthetic checkpoint test. Its cause is unproven. No atomic publication code was changed.
